blogs.title: Why Your AI Model Needs a Traffic Cop: Inside FlashAttention-3's Warp-Specialization
blogs.description: Explore how FlashAttention-3 revolutionizes GPU efficiency by introducing 'producer-consumer' teams. Learn how separating data loading from math calculations allows modern GPUs like the H100 to stop waiting on memory bottlenecks, effectively doubling the speed of Large Language Models.

blogs.title: The Math Behind the Speed: How FlashAttention-3 Hides Softmax Under Computation
blogs.description: Discover the clever engineering trick that lets FlashAttention-3 run complex mathematical operations simultaneously. This post breaks down how the algorithm overlaps slow 'softmax' steps with fast matrix multiplications using a ping-pong scheduling system, squeezing 75% utilization out of your GPU.

blogs.title: FP8 Without the Loss: Achieving Near-Petaflop Speeds with High Accuracy
blogs.description: Switching to low-precision (FP8) usually means sacrificing model quality. See how FlashAttention-3 uses 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing' to tame data outliers, delivering massive speed boosts (up to 1.2 PFLOPs/s) while maintaining 2.6x better accuracy than previous standards.
